headline_marked: Trump's call to FIFA chief: [[USA's Balogun red card suspended]]
headline: Trump's call to FIFA chief: USA's Balogun red card suspended
summary: FIFA has overturned the one-game ban for US striker Folarin Balogun after US President Donald Trump personally called FIFA boss Gianni Infantino.
details: FIFA has suspended the one-game ban for USA striker Folarin Balogun, allowing him to play in the upcoming last-16 match against Belgium.
A source familiar with the matter told AFP that US President Donald Trump called FIFA President Gianni Infantino on Wednesday, the same day the red card was issued.
Following the call, FIFA's governing body officially overturned the suspension on Sunday.
Belgium's football chiefs have expressed astonishment at the decision to lift the ban on the star striker.
President Trump has since thanked FIFA for the decision to allow Balogun to play.
caption:
A phone call from the US President to the FIFA chief. A red card overturned. This is unprecedented.

FIFA has suspended the one-game ban for USA striker Folarin Balogun, allowing him to play in the upcoming last-16 match against Belgium.

A source familiar with the matter told AFP that US President Donald Trump called FIFA President Gianni Infantino on Wednesday, the same day the red card was issued.

Following the call, FIFA's governing body officially overturned the suspension on Sunday.

Belgium's football chiefs have expressed astonishment at the decision to lift the ban on the star striker.

President Trump has since thanked FIFA for the decision to allow Balogun to play.
